text.en:
Upon scoring an Elemental Kill:
Grants 1 stack of Recombination, increasing the damage of the next shot of the weapon.

Maximum of 10 stacks.

Percentage Damage Increase for the next shot:
< table >
|b Stacks |b 1x |b 2x |b 3x |b 4x |b 5x |b 6x |b 7x |b 8x |b 9x |b 10x <center/>
|b PVE    |  8  |  17 |  27 |  38 |  46 |  57 |  68 |  80 |  89 |  100 <center/> <background/>
|b PVP    |  5  |  10 |  15 |  20 |  25 |  30 |  35 |  40 |  45 |  50  <center/>
<$>
text.zh-chs:
元素最后一击时：
获得 1 层增益，提升此武器的下一击伤害。

最高叠加 10 层。

伤害提升数值（%）
< table >
|b 层数 |b 1x |b 2x |b 3x |b 4x |b 5x |b 6x |b 7x |b 8x |b 9x |b 10x <center/>
|b PVE    |  8  |  17 |  27 |  38 |  46 |  57 |  68 |  80 |  89 |  100 <center/> <background/>
|b PVP    |  5  |  10 |  15 |  20 |  25 |  30 |  35 |  40 |  45 |  50  <center/>
<$>

text.en:
Elemental Kill grant 1 Stack of Recombination.
Maximum of #e${10/#d} stacks.

Each Stack increases the damage of the next shot by <pve #e${10*#d}% /> <pvp [#e${5*#d}%] />.

enhanced (
var d = 1.25
#e Damage Buff ramps up 25% faster, reaching maximum strength 2 Stacks sooner.
)
